howto_text_before:
Every day, a Wikipedia article is chosen as the mystery article. Your goal is to find it.

Type any Wikipedia article title to make a guess. For example, if you guess Marie Curie, you might see:
howto_text_after:
The number 6 means Marie Curie and the mystery article have 6 links in common.
If your guess appears as a link on the mystery article, its title will be rendered in blue.

Your guesses are sorted from most to least common links: the higher a guess is in the list, the closer it is to the mystery article.

If you're stuck, hit the hint button: and you will get a random link that is on the mystery page.

There's no guess limit and no timer: explore Wikipedia freely and enjoy yourself.
midnight_message: Midnight has passed and the daily mystery article has changed. Unfortunately your current game can't continue. Ready for today's article?
